name: NGC 2865 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2865, a shell elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc2865-hubble
story: An elliptical galaxy that is unusually young and dynamic for its kind, wrapped in an almost closed shell of cold gas torn from a spiral galaxy it merged with.

claims.text: It is relatively young and dynamic for an elliptical
Gas torn from a spiral galaxy in a merger forms an almost closed shell around it
